verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly list embeddings among the supported model types and direct users to "use embeddings & reranking in search & context retrieval". The REST API reference also covers embedding models, so both halves of the story are delivered on Fireworks itself, with no second vendor. Missing for 10: detailed embeddings/rerank endpoint documentation (model list, API shape), and independent or hands-on corroboration of reranking quality and retrieval usage.
